entity.name: GTs On The Bay
entity.address_line_1: 26189 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA
entity.editorial_summary: Breezy, family-friendly bar/eatery with waterfront views & a menu of seafood & steaks.
entity.description: GTs On The Bay sits overlooking Wolf Bay on Canal Road in the heart of Orange Beach. With stunning views and bay front dining, GTs features a diverse and one-of-a-kind menu. Guests can savor unique culinary choices and a blend of local favorites, in addition to special creations with a family friendly atmosphere. Enjoy a stone hearth pizza oven and fresh made salad bar as well as craft beers and daily happy hour.

items.description: Made fresh daily featuring crisp romaine lettuce, spring mix, and iceberg lettuce, with house-made chicken and pasta salad options. Endless toppings and dressings available.
